## Phase 3 Chunk 2 — Validator report

### 1. Scope
```
$ git diff --stat
 app.py | 6 ++++++
 1 file changed, 6 insertions(+)
```
Tracked change is only `app.py` (import + `@app.route("/profile")`). New delivery files: `api/profile.py`, `templates/profile.html`. No `models.py` edits. Unrelated untracked noise (`.venv/`, `.factory/`, etc.) ignored.

### 2. Auth guard
`api/profile.py` opens with the same pattern as `api/dashboard.py:11-12`:
```python
if "user_id" not in session:
    return redirect(url_for("login"))
```

### 3. No `?id=` parameter
```
@app.route("/profile")
def profile():
    return handle_profile()
```
Handler takes no args; no `request.args` usage.

### 4. DB is source of truth (A3)
```python
profile = get_user_profile(session["user_id"])
return render_template("profile.html", profile=profile)
```
Uses only `session["user_id"]` for lookup. No `session["full_name"]` / `session["username"]` display reads.

### 5. Fail-closed on None (A5)
```python
if profile is None:
    return redirect(url_for("login"))
```

### 6. Template contract
Standalone HTML (no `extends`), reuses navbar + `banking.css`. Fields only:
- `profile.username`, `profile.email`, `profile.full_name`, `profile.address`
No `id` / `created_at`. Flask Jinja autoescape applies to `.html`.

### 7. No nav link
No `/profile` href in `dashboard.html`, `account_detail.html`, `transactions.html`, `transfer.html`.

### 8. Test quality (`test/test_profile_route.py`)
Covers: auth redirect, no-leak on redirect, four field presence, no internal columns, stale session → login (A5), DB-vs-session divergence (A3). Hits real app/client + models; no subject mocks; no tautologies.

### 9. Regression
```
$ .venv/bin/pytest test/test_profile_route.py -v
6 passed in 0.11s

$ .venv/bin/pytest -q
96 passed in 0.25s
```

### Evidence summary
| Check | Result |
|--------|--------|
| Scope | pass |
| Auth guard | pass |
| No `?id=` | pass |
| DB source of truth | pass |
| None → login | pass |
| Template four keys only | pass |
| No nav link | pass |
| Locked tests | 6/6 pass |
| Full suite | 96 pass |

ACCEPT
